name: Warm Choke
description: Seat the stock hard into the shoulder and feel the barrel line settle upon the mark.

name: Breechcount
description: Peer down the muzzle and read the bore for fouling or a stuck wad before loading.

name: Chokepace
description: Advance with the hammer at half-cock and the barrel angled skyward to keep the piece safe while moving.

name: Sawnedge Blow
description: Fire into a doorway from close range so the pellets fan across the whole opening.

name: Bead Stay
description: Drive the butt of the stock into a foe's ribs to break his balance as he closes.

name: Blunt Shell
description: Drop to one knee and rest the elbow on the thigh to fire a steadier single shot.

name: Tending Slugchamber
description: Pour the charge from the horn in one smooth measure so every load burns alike.

name: Beadreview
description: Seat the wad upon the powder with three even strokes of the rod so no gap remains.

name: Warm Pellet
description: Weigh the pellet pouch in the palm and judge by feel whether the load is full.

name: Shellblow
description: Bring the freshly loaded piece to the shoulder in one motion and fire at the nearest threat.

name: Wad Wedge
description: Crouch behind low cover and recharge the piece without lifting the head above it.

name: Wadgauge
description: Carry the short barrel at the hip with the muzzle resting upon the foe's belt line.

name: Pelletdash
description: Swing the barrel across the line of a charging foe and fire as it crosses his chest.

name: Chokedrop
description: Fire round a corner into a narrow lane so the pellets rake the whole width of it.

name: Leaden Pattern
description: Fire once then retreat two paces while the pellet cloud keeps the foe's head down.

name: Towing Spreadshot
description: Thrust the muzzle at a foe's face so he flinches before the shot is even fired.

name: Kept Doublebarrel
description: Tuck the barrel across both forearms to turn aside a blow aimed at the chest.

name: Shifting Pumpgrip
description: Slip a pace sideways off the line of attack while the muzzle stays trained.

name: Pelletcount
description: Roll a few buckshot in the palm to judge their size and the load they suit.

name: Kind Shell
description: Pass a damp swab down the bore to clear residue so the next shot flies clean.

name: Even Pellet
description: Turn the flint in the jaws and test its edge so the hammer throws a sure spark.

name: Sudden Pump
description: Fire a heavy buckshot load at one foe so close that the whole cluster strikes him.

name: Slugchamber Review
description: Ride the kick of the piece with the whole body and bring the muzzle back upon the mark.

name: Descending Slug
description: Fire above a foe's head so the roar and falling pellets drive him back to cover.

name: Shelldash
description: Shoot into a hedge where a foe hides so the pellets rake the leaves and whatever lurks within.

name: Sluglid
description: Hook the barrel behind a foe's ankle and haul to trip him as he runs past.

name: Breechreview
description: Press the cheek to the comb of the stock so the eye lines up over the barrel.

name: Ready Sawnedge
description: Lean the weight through the stock into a braced stance that takes the kick without stumbling.

name: Hard Blast
description: Swing the stock in a short arc against a foe's jaw or temple at close quarters.

name: Fouling Doublebarrel
description: Hook the reversed piece around a foe's arm and wrench his weapon aside.

name: Wad Bump
description: Step back from the foe and fire as the stock settles into the shoulder again.

name: Breechtrot
description: Glide the leading foot forward over bare ground to close the gap without jarring the aim.

name: Even Breech
description: Pass a thread of qi into the powder charge so it burns evenly in the pan.

name: Warm Bead
description: Wrap the pellet load in a thin film of qi so the cluster flies together.

name: Shellreview
description: Run qi along the barrel to feel any warp in it and aim off to match.

name: Pelletdrop
description: Fire a qi-filmed load so the pellets keep a tighter cluster upon the mark.

name: Pellethusk
description: Draw breath and send qi into the shoulder so the kick lands softly and the aim stays.

name: Steady Pumpgrip
description: Judge from the foe's distance how wide the pellets will open before the trigger is pulled.

name: Gnawing Choke
description: Fire a loosely packed load so the pellets open into a wide fan across a knot of foes.

name: Pelletreview
description: Hold qi at the muzzle so the pellet fan does not open too soon.

name: Short Slug
description: Rake the edge of a crowd with the thin side of the fan to pin them behind cover.

name: Quick Pump
description: Draw the fan tight with qi and fire at the centre of one foe for a clean hit.

name: Pulling Pattern
description: Fire at a foe's feet so the flash and smoke dazzle his eyes for a moment.

name: Pumppace
description: Back away in a curve while the lingering fan of pellets covers the retreat.

name: Soft Breech
description: Lean from the doorframe to read the room beyond with the muzzle already leading.

name: Blunt Spreadshot
description: Fire from the threshold across the room so the pellets reach every corner where a foe stands.

name: Flat Sawnedge
description: Fire through a gap in the hedge so the pellets pass cleanly and strike the target beyond.

name: Pulling Pump
description: Kick the door into a foe's face then jab the barrel into his belly.

name: Stepping Doublebarrel
description: Dart from one point of cover to the next with the muzzle held ready the whole way.

name: Settled Pellet
description: Roll behind the hedge base and rest the piece across a root to hold the line.

name: Shell Note
description: Study the scatter left upon a plank and read from it what the load did.

name: Calm Wad
description: Weigh out the pellets by hand and by qi until every measure is the same.

name: Smooth Slugchamber
description: Space the pellets within the load by qi so the pattern keeps an even spread.

name: Quick Blast
description: Fire a measured load at a still mark so the pattern lands even across it.

name: Straight Pattern
description: Fire a thin pattern across open ground so a pinned foe dares not rise.

name: Beaddrop
description: Pack the load toward the centre so the heart of the pattern bites deep into one target.

name: Skipping Breech
description: Shift a pace aside as the shot leaves so the foe's reply meets only empty air.

name: Fouling Buckshot
description: Fire a warning pattern into a post beside a foe to break his nerve.

name: Pumpgrip Gauge
description: Set the cartridge pouch where the hand finds a charge without the eyes looking.

name: Deep Bead
description: Tear the paper cartridge with the teeth and pour its contents down the barrel in one motion.

name: Smooth Choke
description: Prime the pan with a spark of qi so the charge lights at once.

name: Pumpdrop
description: Follow the first shot with a quick recharge and a second shot before the foe recovers.

name: Solid Sawnedge
description: Recharge the piece low behind cover while qi hardens the body against stray hits.

name: Quiet Pellet
description: Retreat while reloading by memory so the piece is ready the moment the foe appears.
